text: 11 On a Mac Mistakes Interview SGLang is an open-source serving engine for language models: software that takes requests over HTTP, batches them onto GPUs and streams tokens back, like vLLM.
label: core
key: radix tree of token runs

text: Its organising idea is to keep the KV cache of every finished request in a radix tree , so that any later request starting with the same tokens (a system prompt, a document, the earlier turns of a chat, an agent's growing history) skips recomputing them.
label: core
key: the KV cache of every finished request in a radix

text: Around that tree it builds a scheduler that can order requests to hit the cache, a scheduler loop that hides its own CPU work behind the GPU, constrained decoding for JSON and grammars, a router that sends each request to the replica most likely to hold its prefix, and recipes for serving DeepSeek-sized mixture-of-experts models on hundreds of GPUs.
label: core
key: scheduler, router and structured-output path are built around reusing that tree
